name: Candidate closes counter-offer probe gracefully — positive signal

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a backend engineer with 6 years across Razorpay and Flipkart, focused on payments infrastructure.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you looking to switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I want to move from payments to core ledger work — that's the next problem space I want to own.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: If we make you an offer and your current company comes back with a counter-offer, how will you handle it?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: If I accept yours, I won't take a counter. Once I sign I'm in — I've already decided that no counter-offer consideration will change my mind. I'd rather not waste your hiring cycle if I'm not committed.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Got it. What's your notice period?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days, buyout possible at 1 month gross. I can also negotiate early release if there's flexibility on your side.
